source_row.stem: A nurse recognizes that grief expression and mourning practices can vary significantly across different cultures, and a colleague suggests it would be simplest to just apply one standard set of expectations to every grieving family regardless of background. Culturally sensitive care instead includes:
source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Discouraging any outward expression of grief within the clinical setting, without much regard for the family's own customs","B":"Assuming every client grieves in the same universal way, without regard for their particular cultural background, similar to what the colleague is currently suggesting","C":"Working with the client and family to honor their own customs around death and mourning whenever this can safely be done","D":"Imposing the nurse's own personal or cultural framework for how grief should appropriately be expressed, similar to the one-size-fits-all approach the colleague is currently suggesting for grief expression"}}
source_row.rationale: Culturally sensitive grief support recognizes that mourning practices and grief expression vary significantly across cultures, and includes respecting and accommodating the specific client/family's practices and beliefs whenever possible.
source_row.source_name: Hospice and Palliative Nursing Foundations — Cultural Variation in Grief
